block.l: Are you sure you want to delete everything from the list?

block.comment: The ELSE part isn't required by the problem, but it's bad user interface design to just silently do nothing -- it makes the user nervous.

block.l: What item should I add to the shopping list?

scripts.comment: 1.5 is in the Clear List sprite.
1.7 is in the Delete Item sprite.

block.l: Enter the item number of the item you want to delete.

scripts.comment: The above is all that's required. But when deleting something, especially selected by number, it's a good idea to get confirmation:

block.l: Enter the item number of the item you want to delete.
